checks.command: /bin/zsh -lc 'git status --short && git rev-parse HEAD && git branch --show-current && find .. -name AGENTS.md -print'

/bin/zsh -lc "rtk --version && rtk git status --short && rtk cat docs/OPERATIONS.md && rtk cat docs/BRIGHTDATA_PROVIDER.md && rtk sed -n '1,190p' docs/ARCHITECTURE.md && rtk sed -n '1,125p' docs/SEARCH_QUALITY.md"

/bin/zsh -lc "rtk rg --files -g 'scripts/**' -g '.github/**' -g '.markdownlint*' -g 'Makefile' -g 'justfile' -g 'tox.ini' -g 'noxfile.py' -g 'pyproject.toml' -g 'package.json' -g 'pre-commit-config.yaml' && rtk rg -n 'R1|not approved|not selected|frozen legacy|pending migration|managed provider|primary discovery path|production-candidate' README.md docs/ARCHITECTURE.md docs/OPERATIONS.md docs/BRIGHTDATA_PROVIDER.md docs/SEARCH_QUALITY.md"
/bin/zsh -lc "rtk git status --short && rtk sed -n '1,24p' README.md && rtk sed -n '1,20p' docs/BRIGHTDATA_PROVIDER.md"

/bin/zsh -lc "rtk rg --files -g '*.md' | xargs rtk rg -n -i 'does not authorize or select|selects no managed provider|not selected for production|a later change will select|R1 establishes the adapter boundary|RUN NOW.*unchanged and frozen|is not the selected Big-3'"
/bin/zsh -lc 'rtk git diff -- README.md docs/ARCHITECTURE.md docs/OPERATIONS.md docs/BRIGHTDATA_PROVIDER.md docs/SEARCH_QUALITY.md'

/bin/zsh -lc "rtk git status --short && rtk git diff --check && rtk rg -n -i 'not selected|no managed provider|pending migration|normal-chrome Big-3|primary discovery path|production-candidate|5,000-record|free-tier|successfully delivered|selected for production|not production-approved|unqualified|RUN_NOW' README.md docs/ARCHITECTURE.md docs/OPERATIONS.md docs/BRIGHTDATA_PROVIDER.md docs/SEARCH_QUALITY.md"
/bin/zsh -lc "rtk sed -n '1,35p' README.md && rtk sed -n '65,125p' README.md && rtk sed -n '1,170p' docs/BRIGHTDATA_PROVIDER.md && rtk git diff --name-only && rtk git status --short"

/bin/zsh -lc "rtk rg -n -i 'not selected for production|selects no managed provider|does not authorize or select|a later change will select|R1 establishes the adapter boundary|first managed production-candidate|single production entry point|today.s fast path|the primary discovery path is ordinary' README.md docs/ARCHITECTURE.md docs/OPERATIONS.md docs/BRIGHTDATA_PROVIDER.md docs/SEARCH_QUALITY.md"

/bin/zsh -lc "rtk rg -n 'Bright Data candidate setup|5,000-record/month|free-tier balance|pay only for successfully delivered|No account-specific|unqualified|selected Big-3 production direction|frozen compatibility' README.md docs/ARCHITECTURE.md docs/OPERATIONS.md docs/BRIGHTDATA_PROVIDER.md docs/SEARCH_QUALITY.md"

/bin/zsh -lc "rtk git diff --stat && rtk rg -n '"'^## (Legacy RUN_NOW|Current RUN_NOW)|selected Big-3 production direction|RUN_NOW has not switched|qualification requires an explicit|task completion gate|SQLite remains authoritative'"' README.md docs/ARCHITECTURE.md docs/OPERATIONS.md docs/BRIGHTDATA_PROVIDER.md docs/SEARCH_QUALITY.md"
/bin/zsh -lc 'rtk git diff --check && rtk git diff --name-only && rtk git status --short'

/bin/zsh -lc "rtk rg -n 'selected Big-3 production direction|RUN_NOW has not switched|Legacy RUN_NOW compatibility setup|Current RUN_NOW compatibility behavior|Legacy runtime boundary|Any qualification must use|qualification requires an explicit|R1 establishes' README.md docs/ARCHITECTURE.md docs/OPERATIONS.md docs/BRIGHTDATA_PROVIDER.md docs/SEARCH_QUALITY.md && rtk git rev-parse HEAD && rtk git branch --show-current"
